## 2. Core Service Capabilities

### 2.1 Web Development & Next.js Architecture
- High-speed modern web applications powered by Next.js App Router, React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, and Node.js.
- Server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), and API integration.
- Responsive design tailored for mobile speed and 100/100 Lighthouse performance.

### 2.2 Mobile App Engineering
- Cross-platform Android & iOS app development using React Native.
- Native Android app development using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
- Firebase integration, push notifications, offline storage, and Play Store publishing.

### 2.3 Custom AI & RAG Solutions
- Building AI Chatbots, document Q&A engines, and automated business workflows using Groq SDK, OpenAI GPT-4o, and Llama 3 models.
- Custom knowledge base embeddings and vector search integrations.

### 2.4 E-Commerce & SaaS Systems
- Custom online stores with Razorpay, Cashfree, UPI, and Credit Card payment gateways.
- Multi-tenant SaaS billing, order tracking, and invoice generation.
